SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Special Branch Registration Station,
No. S. B. D. 1470.
Date July 28, 1930.
ate 31-7-30.）
Subject (in full) O.N. Kohnert.
Made by D.S. Faddeeff. Forwarded by W Kounean DSJ
Sir,
With reference to attached, a confidential interview
with Mr. O.N. Kohnert was obtained and he volunteered the
following information regarding the closing of the Vladivostok
branch of "Kunst & Albers."
There are two firms named "Kunst & Albers" and two
brothers, (1) Gustav and (2) Alfred Albers, are the owners.
Gustav is a German subject and is the proprietor of
branches of above firm in Hamburg, Harbin and Shanghai,
while Alfred Albers is a Soviet subject and is the proprietor
of branches in Vladivostok, Nikolsk-Ussurriysk, Habarovsk
and Nikolaevsk-on Amur (Soviet Russia). Both of them reside
in Hamburg, and since 1922 they have been acting seperately
and there has been no connection between the branches of the
two brothers, therefore Mr. K. Chaefer the Manager of the local
branch of "Kunst & Albers" can say nothing about the sealing
of the branch in Vladivostok and other branches in Soviet Russia.
The branches belonging to Alfred Albers in Vladivostok,
Nikolaevsk-on Amur, Nikolsk-Ussurriysk and Habarovsk were
conducting their business under the control of "Finotdel"
(Financial Department of Soviet Authorities) and in January
1925, all their premises were taken over (nationalised) by
the Soviet Government. The owner was then allowed to occupy
the premises for a certain rent. In June 1930 the Control
Committee of "Finotdel" visited the Vladivostok branch of
"Kunst & Albers" with a view to checking the work of the
business and they found many discrepancies in their accounts.
In the end of June the firm received a demand for the sum of
1,383,888.01 roubles for Government contributions for the past

主题（全称） O.N. Kohnert。
撰写人 D.S. Faddeeff。转呈人 W Kounean DSJ
先生，
关于附件，已与 O.N. Kohnert 先生进行了一次秘密谈话，他自愿提供了以下关于“Kunst & Albers”海参崴分行关闭的信息。
有两家名为“Kunst & Albers”的公司，其所有者是两兄弟，(1) Gustav 和 (2) Alfred Albers。
Gustav 是德国籍臣民，拥有上述公司在汉堡、哈尔滨和上海的分行，而 Alfred Albers 是苏联籍臣民，拥有在海参崴、乌苏里斯克（Nikolsk-Ussurriysk）、哈巴罗夫斯克（Habarovsk）和阿穆尔河畔尼古拉耶夫斯克（Nikolaevsk-on Amur）（苏俄）的分行。两人均居住在汉堡，自1922年以来他们一直分开经营，两兄弟的分行之间没有任何联系，因此“Kunst & Albers”本地分行的经理 K. Chaefer 先生对海参崴分行及苏俄其他分行的查封一事无可奉告。
Alfred Albers 所属的海参崴、阿穆尔河畔尼古拉耶夫斯克、乌苏里斯克和哈巴罗夫斯克分行在“Finotdel”（苏维埃当局财政部）的控制下开展业务，1925年1月，其所有场所均被苏联政府接管（国有化）。随后允许业主以一定的租金占用这些场所。1930年6月，“Finotdel”管理委员会视察了“Kunst & Albers”的海参崴分行，旨在检查该企业的运营情况，发现其账目存在许多不符之处。6月底，该公司收到一项要求，需缴纳过去

It is believed that "Kunst & Albers" were expecting such

distributed between the Daltorg (Far East Trade Mission)
and the Central Labourers Co-operative.
The 127 employees of the firm were paid off by the
"Finotdel" and given three months wages in lieu of notice.
Mr. O.N. Kohnert arrived in Shanghai by s.s. "Witell"

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Special Branch Registration Station,
No. S. B. D. 1470.
Date July 22, 1930.
ate 22 - 7 - 30.

Subject (in full) Mr. O.N. Kohnert.

Made by D.S. Faddeeff. Forwarded by Whuncar LSI

Information has been received from reliable sources
that Mr. O.N. Kohnert, Manager of the Vladivostok branch
of the well known firm "Kunst & Albers," fled from
Vladivostok with his wife on board a German ship and
landed at Woosung on 19-7-30. He is residing at No. 11
Lorton Terrace off Rue Lorton, French Concession.
According to information received the Vladivostok branch
of "Kunst & Albers" was sealed by the Soviet Authorities
for non payment of contributions in the sum of 1,385,000.00
Roubles, and Mr. O.N. Kohnert being Manager of above firm
was expecting to be arrested in connection with the case.
It is believed that Mr. Kohnert and his wife were placing
on board ship with the assistance of the German Consul
in Vladivostok. Mr. O.N. Kohnert is a native of Germany,
but before the Great War he became a naturalized Russian
subject. It is his intention to regain his German
nationality if possible.
The firm of "Kunst & Albers" has a branch at No.
29 Szechuen Road.

D. Faddeeff
D. S.

D. C.
(C. & S. Branches)

主题（全称） O.N. Kohnert 先生。

撰写人 D.S. Faddeeff。转呈人 Whuncar LSI

从可靠来源获悉，著名商行“Kunst & Albers”海参崴分行经理 O.N. Kohnert 先生与其妻子乘坐一艘德国船只逃离海参崴，并于1930年7月19日在吴淞登陆。他现居住于法租界罗顿路（Rue Lorton）旁罗顿里（Lorton Terrace）11号。
根据收到的信息，“Kunst & Albers”海参崴分行因未缴纳总额为 1,385,000.00 卢布的缴款而被苏维埃当局查封，作为上述商行的经理，O.N. Kohnert 先生预计自己将因此案被捕。
据信，Kohnert 先生及其妻子是在海参崴德国领事的协助下登船的。O.N. Kohnert 先生原籍德国，但在大战前已归化为俄罗斯籍臣民。他打算尽可能恢复其德国国籍。
“Kunst & Albers”商行在四川路29号设有一家分行。

D. Faddeeff
D. S.

D. C.
（刑事与特别科）

（批：已收）
